term: uniting cause versus efficient cause versus cause of being
resolution: COMPOSITE-UNITING-CAUSE-FROM-UNION keeps the three relations as separate parameters. Unites (DEF-UNITING-CAUSE) is the third proof's causa adunans. STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-IS-EFFICIENT passes from it only to efficient causing in SOME respect, which is all that STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF needs to exclude the composite as its own uniter. STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-CAUSES-COMPOSITE-BEING passes separately from uniting to CausesIn c x esse, the relation of the conclusion. No premise passes from efficient causing to CausesIn or back, so the argument never treats an efficient cause as a cause of being, or a cause of being as efficient, except through the two stated premises about the same uniter. Controls 3 and 4 of COMPOSITE-UNITING-CAUSE-CONTROLS show that neither passage follows from the other. The new temporal fork keeps the original temporally unspecified composer attribution independent. Selected-time and existential-admitted-time calibrations are explicit propositions, with overlap and a precise remainder. Historical production reaches the original current efficient-composer bridge only with explicit uniter persistence. A separate checked route reaches the SAME distinct-uniter conclusion using all-time no-self instead, without persistence. Selected-time no-self alone is insufficient, as the nonvacuous past-self model shows. No existing source claim selects either calibration. Sense fork (docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md, TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks2): Senses are labelled UNITING-CAUSE_1 uniting, UNITING-CAUSE_2 efficient causing, UNITING-CAUSE_3 causing being (CausesIn c x esse) and UNITING-CAUSE_4 the temporal composer profile. The primary results are one argument per sense to STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE: COMPOSITE-HAS-UNITING-CAUSE-UNITING-CAUSE-1 (open STMT-NOTHING-UNITES-ITSELF), the existing COMPOSITE-UNITING-CAUSE-FROM-UNION for sense 2, COMPOSITE-HAS-UNITING-CAUSE-UNITING-CAUSE-3 (open STMT-NOTHING-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-BEING) and the existing COMPOSITE-UNITING-CAUSE-FROM-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION for sense 4. UnitingSense enumerates senses 1-3 and UnitingFrame.CausesBy unfolds each to the existing parameter. Coverage (STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE) and exclusivity of the route's reading (STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-SENSE-UNIQUE) are OPEN frontier premises. The optional summary UNITING-CAUSE-SENSE-FORK-COMPOSITE-HAS-UNITING-CAUSE reaches STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-A-UNITING-CAUSE whichever single sense both uses of 'causes' take; its controls show that reading the two uses in different senses (uniter as uniting, no-self as efficient) breaks the step.
